##### Project general facts

Binghatti Cullinan by Binghatti is a mixed-use residential development designed in the developer's signature style, where clean lines and strict geometric forms create a recognisable silhouette that sits in harmony with its surroundings. The building rises above a basement, a ground floor and four podium levels to fourteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with commercial units.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool with a children's pool and a poolside terrace, a fully equipped indoor gym and a full-size sports court for an active routine. Seminar rooms and shared desk spaces support those working from home, while cafes, restaurants, retail outlets, walking paths and relaxation and social zones add everyday convenience, complemented by a welcoming lobby, lifts, covered parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance.

Interiors follow a contemporary style with high-quality materials, efficient layouts and large windows that bring natural light into the living spaces. Compact studios and family apartments suit professionals, couples and investors seeking a well-connected central address. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Jaddaf and Creek metro stations are close by. Al Wasl Club and Wafi Mall are a short drive away, Dubai Festival City and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary are close by, and Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
